summary: Asked the agent to implement a referenced plan document. It loaded `hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development` and `hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees` and began executing in a worktree, but never loaded `executing-plans` (no Skill call, no SKILL.md read).
reasoning: The only acceptance criterion requires an executing-plans skill load before execution. The authoritative session log shows only two Skill invocations, neither of them executing-plans, and no shell read of an executing-plans SKILL.md, while implementation work (gitignore commit, ledger write, npm test) had already begun.

observations.description: Agent chose the subagent-driven-development path instead of executing-plans. A CLAUDE.md-level preference present in the run context explicitly says: '[redacted: quoted from host CLAUDE.md]' (found via grep in the session log). This fixture instruction appears to steer the agent away from the skill the story expects.

Namespace mismatch: the story/criterion names the skill `superpowers:executing-plans`, but all skills in this build are namespaced `hyperpowers:` (e.g. hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development). If the criterion is literal, no `superpowers:`-prefixed skill can ever be loaded here.

HOWTO claims the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but launching still required four interactive dialogs: theme picker, security notes, folder-trust prompt, and bypass-permissions warning.
Despite 'never stall to ask permission' guidance, the agent stalled twice with AskUserQuestion prompts (worktree location, CommonJS vs ESM) before implementing anything.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded superpowers:executing-plans skill before executing the plan
criteria.evidence: grep over the session logs at $HOME/.claude/projects: `grep -rho '"skill":"[^"]*"' .` returned only `1 "skill":"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development"` and `1 "skill":"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees"`. `grep -rho 'skills/executing-plans/SKILL.md' . | wc -l` returned 0. Screen confirms: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development)' and '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees)' with 'Executing with Subagent-Driven Development...', and the agent had already written files (Write of progress.md, .gitignore commit, npm test run) without any executing-plans load.
